So copying all points is equivalent — boundary values are the same in both arrays.

The swap happens after the error read in the refactored version, but this doesn't affect the error value (error is computed in jacobi_step, not swap_data). The swap still completes before the next iteration's `cudaMemset` (which also implicitly synchronizes). So this reordering is functionally correct.

7. **`cudaMemset` size**: Source uses `4`, refactored uses `sizeof(float)` — both are 4 bytes, equivalent.
